title: Mickey Moone channels 50s rock & roll memories with “Take It Easy”
htmlContent: Mickey Moone's latest song, "Take It Easy," feels like a train rolling down the tracks, Moone brings the spirit of classic rock & roll back to life. Inspired by the sounds of the '50s that echoed from his dad's boom box when he was growing up in the '80s, "Take It Easy" feels like that favorite old leather jacket you never want to take off, it's timeless, easygoing, and undeniably cool. The way Moone strums his guitar gives the song a lively energy, while his lead guitar adds a dreamy quality, making it feel fresh and exciting as if it were pulled directly from an old record but crafted for today's listeners. Moone's singing stands out on its own, featuring a catchy melody that draws on the charm of early pop-rock. https://open.spotify.com/track/3OH4JrrGwxS2K6kQXnh3GL?si=cyLLZZ2jTjW-PEUKpSNibg It feels focused and intentional, filled with the classic vibes of legendary artists like Buddy Holly and Roy Orbison. Mickey Moone is looking back at the roots of rock & roll and showing us why they still matter today. This song is full of memories but has a lively energy that invites you to move along.
